title: λ-biharmonic Riemannian submersions from manifolds with constant sectional curvature
summary: In this paper, we study λ-biharmonic Riemannian submersions, which generalize biharmonic Riemannian submersions. We prove nonexistence results for λ-biharmonic Riemannian submersions from (n + 1)-dimensional Riemannian manifolds with constant sectional curvature c to n-dimensional Riemannian manifolds. Our results show that the critical value λ= 2(n - 1)c plays a decisive role. We prove that if c \ge 0, or if c < 0 and λ\ne 2(n - 1)c, then any λ-biharmonic Riemannian submersion must be harmonic.
